liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing On The Moon** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls it the best Standing on the Moon they ever heard; Reviewer calls it the best song they ever heard live, with Jerry's voice and guitar sounding melting and soft [7][8][9][16]
- **Comes A Time** (1 review): Soundcheck rehearsal take is nearly complete and beautiful, a rarely played song in the band's final years [12]

## The recordings

- **gd94-04-06.set1-fob.set2-sbd.miller.28358.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 174 min; rated 2.2/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1994-04-06.snchk.fm-sbd.miller.gmb-fixed.91391.flac16**: soundboard; 4 songs; 29 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd94-04-06.sndchk.sbd.miller.13110.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 2 songs; 22 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [6]. Said about its sound: Soundcheck soundboard recording with band chatter and many Jerry takes between songs; reviewer says it's a great copy [10]
- **gd1994-04-06.141427.OTS.AKG.Ackerman.Miller.Noel.t-flac.1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 152 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the sound crew was no longer Healy, and says they weren't a fan of that change [9]
- Soundcheck recording includes a blind man giving a massage; commenter says a blind friend was Jerry's East Coast massage therapist since the mid-1980s [11]
- Reviewer says this show redeems the weak Orlando show played the night before [7]
- Reviewer says this show redeems the weak Orlando show played the night before [8]
- Reviewer ranks this Standing on the Moon near the 3-27-94 Dew and 3-21-94 Stella, which they rate slightly higher [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-04-06.set1-fob.set2-sbd.miller.28358.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 mixed sources, incl soundcheck: Set 1: (FOB) Schoeps MK4> Dat> CD, Set 2: SBD> Dat> CD, Encore: (FOB) Schoeps MK4> Dat> CD, Soundcheck: SBD> Dat>… [1]. Also: Mixed sources: sets one and encore from Schoeps MK4 audience recording; set two from soundboard; soundcheck from soundboard; Transferred and edited by Charlie Miller using Samplitude Professional 8.0 and converted to FLAC [1]
- **gd1994-04-06.snchk.fm-sbd.miller.gmb-fixed.91391.flac16**: transferred by Bill Koucky; source: FM SB Monitor > Sony D-6 Cassette > 1st gen > DAT [5]. Also: Source 2 soundboard went DAT to MiniDisc to Cool Edit Pro; Charlie Miller handled the transfer, crossfades and speed adjustments [5]
- **gd94-04-06.sndchk.sbd.miller.13110.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>Dat>MiniDisc>Behringer UltraMatch SRC2000>Dio2448>Cool Edit Pro>SHN [6]
- **gd1994-04-06.141427.OTS.AKG.Ackerman.Miller.Noel.t-flac.1648**: taped by Ray Ackerman; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Master Audience Recording & Transfer by Ray Ackerman: AKG 460B/CK63 ULS > AKG B18 phantom power unit > Panasonic SV250 > DAT (OTS); Transfer… [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead the band miami arena april 6, 1994](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/band-miami-arena-april-6-1994) [20]
